mapper.select: SELECT 'knowledge' AS module, id, knowledge_name AS title, LEFT(knowledge_content, 200) AS snippet_raw, DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS update_time FROM t_knowledge WHERE MATCH(knowledge_name, knowledge_content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) ORDER BY MATCH(knowledge_name, knowledge_content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) DESC, update_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'file' AS module, id, original_name AS title, LEFT(remark, 200) AS snippet_raw, DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS update_time FROM t_attachment
del_flag = '0'
AND (original_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '/' OR remark LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '/')
ORDER BY update_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
